expected_behaviours: Agent reads both SPEC and PLAN status fields
Agent detects that PLAN is APPROVED while SPEC is still DRAFT
Agent identifies this as an impossible state in the Spec-Kit phase model
Agent refuses to proceed to TASKS phase
Agent flags the cross-artifact inconsistency to the human

Agent asks human to clarify which artifact reflects the true current state
must_not_behaviours: Accept PLAN APPROVED status and proceed to TASKS phase
Treat SPEC DRAFT as a minor inconsistency and continue

Ignore the SPEC status when PLAN already appears approved
